description: Source code for the abstract class 'MatrixCode' which serves as a base for 2D barcode representations in the PDFsharp library, including properties for encoding, size, and rendering.

classes.name: MatrixCode
classes.description: Abstract base class for all 2D barcode types, managing properties like encoding, size, and image rendering.

methods.name: MatrixCode
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matrix code with text, encoding, size, and dimensions.

methods.name: Encoding
methods.description: Property to get or set the encoding string used in the matrix code.

methods.name: Columns
methods.description: Property to get or set the number of columns in the matrix code.

methods.name: Rows
methods.description: Property to get or set the number of rows in the matrix code.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Property to get or set the text content of the code.

methods.name: MatrixImage
methods.description: Internal property to get or set the generated image of the matrix code; throws if null when accessed.

methods.name: HasMatrixImage
methods.description: Boolean property indicating whether the matrix image has been generated.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Abstract method to render the 2D code onto a graphics context.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Method to validate if a string can be used as text for this matrix code type.
